description: Assess peer comparability, normalize sourced values and calculate relative metrics/statistics; do not infer intrinsic value or investment suitability from multiples alone.

routing.when_to_use: Use when building a selected peer set and comparing sourced operating metrics and valuation multiples as of a defined date.
when_not_to_use: A different atomic task has its own skill
Requested output is an unapproved action or external effect
exclusion_rules: No system mutation or external communication
ambiguity_rules: Continue unaffected work and request only facts that materially change the result

required_inputs.name: scope_and_source_inputs
required_inputs.description: target entity/question; valuation date; peer candidates and selection rationale; consistent period/units/currency; sourced market cap, debt/cash, revenue, EBITDA, net income and any industry metrics; definitions/adjustments; audience.

expected_outputs.name: task_work_product
expected_outputs.description: peer-selection table, raw inputs and sources, normalized operating/valuation metrics, median/quartile distribution, outlier/exclusion notes and interpretation limits.

forbidden_actions: Mutation of company, fund, Odoo, accounting, payroll or source records
Payments, filings, signatures, publications, messages, approvals, trades or transaction commitments
Inventing current law, jurisdiction, entity/fund applicability or missing facts
verification_steps: 1. Define question (valuation, growth, efficiency, cash generation), date, audience, industry and target scope. 2. Establish peer criteria before gathering values: business model, product mix, scale, geography, growth, margins and fiscal period. Exclude or flag conglomerates/distressed/non-comparable names; do not force peer counts. 3. Collect market and financial inputs from available authorized institutional sources or cited filings; record each as-of date, currency, period, reported/adjusted basis and source. If current/market data is unavailable, use supplied snapshots and label stale. 4. Normalize currency, units, fiscal timing, LTM/annual basis and one-time items using transparent adjustments; do not merge quarter and LTM values. 5. Compute margin/growth and EV = market capitalization + debt − cash; multiples use EV numerator with revenue/EBITDA, P/E with market cap/net income. Show formulas and mark not meaningful if denominator≤0. 6. Select 5–10 relevant operating/valuation metrics based on the question; industry metrics only when defined/sourced. Compute median and quartiles for comparable ratios/multiples; report sample size and exclusions. Do not use arithmetic average of percentages as the default benchmark. 7. Analyze range and distribution, explain comparability limitations and avoid calling low multiple “undervalued” without a causal thesis. 8. Provide source table, formulas, peer rationale and sensitivity if requested; no trade/deal instruction.
Show formulas/denominators, evidence dates and assumptions; preserve unresolved conflicts.
Write only a requested private draft; no external effects.
completion_criteria: Conditional task scope is evidenced or limitations explicitly bound
Task method and calculation are reproducible from cited inputs
Owner decisions, open issues and source limitations are explicit

telemetry.retention_policy: opaque task/source IDs and hashes only
